stories.title: SAMPADA data claims lower anaemia prevalence in India than previous surveys
stories.summary: Data put out by the Ministry of health and Family Welfare as per the latest SAMPADA (Survey for Assessment of Markers of Population Health, Activity, Diet and Anthropometry), claims a drop in prevalence of anaemia levels across age and gender groups.

stories.title: GSK India launches multiple myeloma drug
stories.summary: British drugmaker GSK’s subsidiary GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals (GSK India), as part of a strategy to sharpen focus on cancer therapies, on Tuesday announced the launch of monoclonal antibody-drug conjugate BLENREP (belantamab mafodotin) as a combination therapy for those with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. The launch marks introduction of GSK’s third precision oncology therapy in India.

stories.title: From biscuits and bread to packaged juices: Endocrinologist explains the hidden sources of sugar in everyday Indian foods
stories.summary: Hidden sugars and everyday carbohydrates can affect blood sugar levels. Doctor explains how mindful eating and portion control can help manage diabetes. When people think of sugar, they often associate it with foods that taste sweet, such as candies, desserts and sugary beverages.

stories.title: Glass skin without the 10-step routine: 5 hydrating K-beauty products worth trying
stories.summary: Every product we recommend is chosen through a combination of Primary Research and Secondary Research . Shweta Pandey is a Senior Content Writer at Hindustan Times, with over 12 years of experience in beauty and wellness journalism, specialising in makeup, skincare, and hair care. She began her professional writing journey in 2011, entering the evolving world of digital lifestyle journalism as beauty and wellness content rapidly transformed in India.

stories.title: When public duty meets medical privacy
stories.summary: Sonia Gandhi, in her recently published memoir, recalls being advised surgery for suspected breast cancer in 2010. Since she is a prominent public figure, she wonders, in her book, whether she was entitled to even a modicum of privacy with regard to her health. S. Babu (now deceased).

stories.title: The cow, the flea and the genome: One Health and the statecraft of prevention
stories.summary: In the second of his Major Rock Edicts, cut into stone in the third century BCE, Ashoka records that he has provided medical care of two kinds, for people and for animals, and has had healing herbs planted wherever they were lacking. Twenty-three centuries before the phrase existed, an Indian State treated the health of humans, animals and the land as a single charge of government.

stories.title: MPSC Officer Allegedly Printed 300 Drug Inspector Exam Questions, Handed Copies To Superior In Parking Lot
stories.summary: According to the chargesheet, Nakate allegedly involved Under Secretary Abhijit Lendve in the conspiracy to ensure that he would have the protection of a senior official if the irregularity came to light. Nakate was responsible for handling the ‘meta set’ of questions at the Commission’s Navi Mumbai office, from which the final question paper was prepared.

stories.title: Over 6,500 lung cancer cases reported in prominent Delhi hospitals in six years; one death every three days
stories.summary: Around 83 cases of lung cancer were recorded every month across prominent government hospitals in the national capital in the last six and a half year period, with one patient succumbing to the disease every three days. This information was provided in response to an RTI query to AIIMS, RML Hospital, Safdarjung Hospital and the Delhi State Cancer Institute.

stories.title: India-Nepal joint military exercise begins in Rupandehi
stories.summary: A joint military training exercise between Nepal and India, focusing on disaster management, forest welfare and humanitarian assistance, commenced on Wednesday (November 25, 2026). The 20th edition of the training exercise, “Abhyas Suryakiran”, began at Nepal Army Battle School in Saljhandi, Rupandehi district, according to a press release issued by the Nepal Army.

stories.title: Asian women 'never heard' on health, says director
stories.summary: A community centre director in Luton said a "hidden generation" of Asian women had "voices that were never heard" when it came to their wellbeing. The Let Women Speak report , external commissioned by the borough council in Luton, where the onset of poor female health happens five years earlier than average, also found over 70% of women aged 45-64 had an at-risk body mass index.

stories.title: Punjab Kings appoint Paras Mhambrey as fast bowling coach
stories.summary: Punjab Kings have appointed Paras Mhambrey as their fast bowling coach ahead of the 2027 Indian Premier League (IPL). The former India pacer was previously with Mumbai Indians. The 54-year-old, who played 91 first-class games for Mumbai between 1992 and 2003 besides five international games for India, comes to the Punjab-based franchise with loads of coaching experience.

stories.title: Ben Stokes enters IPL 2027 auction at maximum base price
stories.summary: Asia Cup-winning stars Aaryavir Sehwag and Mohit Ulva have registered for the IPL 2027 auction after their impressive performances in the tournament, as per reports from Cricbuzz . Both youngsters were part of India's title-winning campaign in Oman, where the team defeated Pakistan by one wicket in a thrilling final.

stories.title: Jeakson’s late strike keeps East Bengal alive in Asia
stories.summary: It wasn’t till the 87th minute that East Bengal’s night turned from grim to a fairy tale. With Jordan’s World Cup players on the roster, Al Hussein had created chance after chance and hit the framework four times. On other occasions, Phurba Lachenpa kept East Bengal in the game they had to win to stay alive in Asian Champions League 2.

stories.title: 'Never Expected Him To Attack Me Personally': Usman Khawaja Makes Emotional Admission After Pat Cummins' Explosive Sandpapergate Press Conference
stories.summary: Former Australia opener Usman Khawaja has revealed that he was left deeply hurt by Pat Cummins' explosive press conference addressing the infamous 2018 Sandpapergate scandal. Khawaja admitted that he never expected the Australian captain to personally attack him while responding to allegations made in his recently released autobiography, Sabr.

stories.title: World chess championship: Gritty Gukesh weathers time pressure, holds Sindarov
stories.summary: There was this man-against-machine match in chess in 1998. If you thought the machine might have won, you are wrong. The man, named Viswanathan Anand, beat Fritz. The computer had white pieces and it opted for the Spanish Game. Anand, who hadn’t yet won any of his World titles yet, played the Berlin Defence.

stories.title: Sooryavanshi, 15, breaks sixes record in 204 off 53 balls
stories.summary: India's 15-year-old batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hit the most sixes ever recorded in a senior men's innings in blazing 204 from 53 balls for India A against the United Arab Emirates. While almost halving the record for the fastest double-century in List A cricket, Sooryavanshi hit 28 sixes and seven fours in the Asia Cup Rising Stars competition - easily breaking Chad Bowes' previous record of 103 balls from 2024 .

stories.title: Leaked FIFA documents show Infantino’s 96-year private equity plan for World Cup
stories.summary: The leaked documents, including a FIFA in-house risk assessment, show its own finance officials “were not directly privy to the construction of this transaction”

stories.title: ‘ICC, boards need to step in’: Harbhajan on India-Pakistan cricket skirmishes
stories.summary: The last couple of India-Pakistan cricket contests, while they've provided plenty of excitement, have also seen ugly scenes of skirmishes between the players. On November 14, India's Under-19 players had a go at their Pakistani counterparts, celebrating wildly and overenthusiastically after pipping their arch-rivals by one wicket in a thrilling Under-19 Asia Cup final at Al Amerat in Oman.

stories.title: India, Pakistan players' conduct shameful: Harbhajan
stories.summary: India versus Pakistan cricket matches across levels and age groups have recently been marred by ill-behaviour from players of both sides, and former India spinner Harbhajan Singh believes it is time for the International Cricket Council (ICC) and the respective Boards to step in. At the recent U-19 Asia Cup, players from both sides engaged in some over-the-top celebrations after winning.

stories.title: Why Ben Stokes could become the costliest player at the IPL auction
stories.summary: Former England captain Ben Stokes could emerge as the costliest buy at the upcoming IPL mini-auction, scheduled to be held in Goa on December 16. Stokes, who has represented three IPL franchises in the past, is expected to trigger a bidding war between Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) and Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR).

stories.title: Asia Cup heroes Aaryavir Sehwag and Mohit Ulva in IPL auction register; Ben Stokes, Sonny Baker in too
stories.summary: Aaryavir Sehwag, son of legendary Indian opener Virender Sehwag , has registered for the upcoming IPL 2027 auction. Aaryavir, who was instrumental in India’s title-winning campaign during the recently concluded Under-19 Asia Cup, has set his base price at ₹ 30 lakh. India’s hero in the tournament final against Pakistan, Mohit Ulva, has also registered for the auction at the same base price.

stories.title: Champions League: Bellingham wondergoal helps Real Madrid thump PSV; Arsenal and Man City held
stories.summary: Jude Bellingham came off the bench to score a spectacular goal as ​Real Madrid maintained their perfect Champions League start with a 5-1 comeback victory over PSV Eindhoven on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), while ‌Arsenal were held 1-1 at home by Borussia Dortmund and Manchester City drew ​2-2 with Napoli.

stories.title: ICC Test Rankings: Bumrah closes in on No. 1 return, three Indian batters in top 10
stories.summary: Bumrah climbed three places to joint-second, level with England's Ollie Robinson, after taking five wickets in the match. Australia's Mitchell Starc remains at the top, 25 rating points ahead of the pair. The Indian fast bowler made an impact in both innings. He returned figures of 4 for 92 in New Zealand's first innings, dismissing captain Tom Latham, Daryl Mitchell, Tom Blundell and Matt Henry.

stories.title: ‘50-ball 200 is crazy’: Jacob Oram weighs in on Sooryavanshi as ODI's 'saviour'
stories.summary: Sooryavanshi has taken the cricketing world by storm with his astonishing exploits, most recently smashing a breathtaking 204 off just 53 balls in a List A match on Tuesday. The knock has also reignited the debate over the relevance of ODI cricket amid the growing popularity of T20s.

stories.title: India tour of New Zealand: New Zealand vs India second Test in Christchurch preview
stories.summary: On October 20, the Men in Blue arrived from India, shook off the jetlag and began their tour with a stunning victory in the first T20I. Five weeks later, their counterparts in whites are back on the South Island, hoping to replicate those heroics and sign off with a Test victory that would complete a series whitewash.

stories.title: Northants begin T20 Blast defence at Hampshire
stories.summary: Northamptonshire Steelbacks will begin the defence of their T20 Blast crown with a repeat of last season's final, travelling to Hampshire Hawks on Friday, 21 May. It is one of nine back-to-back men's and women's matches happening across the opening weekend of the 2027 campaign as the competition celebrates its 25th edition.

stories.title: Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom
stories.summary: Donald Trump awarded Rudy Giuliani, his former personal attorney who was disbarred for his efforts to help the US president overturn 2020 election results , with the presidential medal of freedom on Tuesday. “I am honored and humbled to receive the Presidential Medal of Freedom from my nation and from President Donald J Trump,” Giuliani, 82, wrote in an X post hours after the award had been presented to him.

stories.title: Sooryavanshi smashes fastest List A double hundred
stories.summary: India’s teenage batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi etched his name in the history books on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), shattering the world record for the fastest double hundred in List A cricket with a 52-ball blitz against the UAE in the Rising Stars Asia Cup. Sooryavanshi surpassed the record held by Chad Bowes, who scored a 200 off 103 balls for Canterbury against Otago in the Ford Trophy in 2024.

stories.title: Imesha Dulani, Sathya Sandeepani star as Sri Lanka beat Ireland to win Women's Emerging Nations Trophy
stories.summary: Sri Lanka produced a commanding all-round performance to defeat Ireland by six wickets and clinch the ICC Women's Emerging Nations Trophy 2026 on Wednesday. Sri Lanka's bowlers bundle out Ireland for 96After opting to bat first, Ireland endured a disastrous start, losing captain Gaby Lewis in the opening over at 5/1.

stories.title: Russia accuses NATO member Estonia of hostile actions ‘on the verge of unleashing open war’
stories.summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry has lashed out at Estonia's government, accusing the NATO member of carrying out a range of "hostile actions" and putting the Baltic state "on the verge of unleashing open war" with Moscow. The outburst underscores rising tensions between Russia and countries on NATO's eastern flank and comes after Estonia announced it will close its road border crossings with Russia from Dec.

stories.title: AFC Champions League Two: East Bengal takes on Al-Hussein in a must-win tie
stories.summary: East Bengal FC faces a decisive test in its continental campaign as it hosts Jordan’s Al-Hussein SC at the Salt Lake Stadium in a Group D clash of the AFC Champions League Two on Tuesday. With qualification for the round of 16 hanging in the balance, the red and gold brigade approaches the penultimate round of the group stage knowing that a victory is essential to keep its hopes alive.

stories.title: U14 Giles Shield Cricket Tournament : Tanish Kadam's 170, Ranveer Singh's 169 Headline Massive Wins For Cardinal Gracis & Sri Maa Vidyalaya
stories.summary: Tanish struck an unbeaten 170 to power Cardinal Gracis High School to a comprehensive 221-run victory over Oberoi International School at the MB Union Ground, Cross Maidan. Cardinal Gracis posted 303-4 before Ayaan Shaikh (3/10) and Saksham Sharma (3/9) helped dismiss the opposition for 82. Ranveer Singh hammered an unbeaten 169 as Sri Maa Vidyalaya registered a massive 506-run victory over Bhakti Vedanta Swami Mission School.

stories.title: IND vs NZ: India targets first New Zealand Test series win in 17 years in Christchurch
stories.summary: On October 20, the Men in Blue arrived from India, shook off the jetlag and began their tour with a stunning victory in the first T20I. Five weeks later, their counterparts in whites are back on the South Island, hoping to replicate those heroics and sign off with a Test victory that would complete a series whitewash.

stories.title: Lincoln sack head coach duo Cohen and Shaw
stories.summary: Lincoln City have sacked their head coaches Chris Cohen and Tom Shaw just six months after they took joint charge of the Championship side. The pair departed a little over 12 hours after they oversaw a 4-0 defeat at fellow strugglers Charlton Athletic on Tuesday. The loss leaves the Imps just three points above the relegation places in what is the club's first season back in the second tier for 65 years.

stories.title: Tilak Varma stunned by Sooryavanshi's 204, explains comments after Pakistan loss
stories.summary: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi displayed remarkable power-hitting by scoring 204 runs off just 53 balls. He broke the record for the fastest List A century, achieving it in only 28 balls. 2 overs during the Rising Stars Asia Cup. Captain Tilak Varma praised Sooryavanshi’s performance and explained the team's batting approach following their loss to Pakistan A.

stories.title: 'Ridiculous': Sanjay Manjrekar raises concern after Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's 204
stories.summary: In a groundbreaking performance, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi scored 204 runs in just 53 balls during the Rising Stars Asia Cup against the UAE, etching his name in cricket history. His innings prompted discussions on the balance of play in modern white-ball formats, with Sanjay Manjrekar expressing both admiration for Sooryavanshi's prowess and unease about the sport's trajectory.

stories.title: Amid challenges, Zaheer Khan determined to make mixed-gender cricket a success story
stories.summary: Imagine Deepti Sharma bowling to Glenn Phillips, or Smriti Mandhana taking strike against Nandre Burger . For the longest time, the concept of men and women competing in the same professional cricket match seemed like a distant dream. But thanks to one of India’s finest cricketers, it may be closer than you think.

stories.title: What are the disputes between Iraq's federal government and Kurdistan region?
stories.summary: The orders are part of a broader crackdown by Zaidi against oil smuggling. They also reopen long-running disputes between Baghdad and the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) over control of oil, money, territory and trade. Though Baghdad says state oil marketer SOMO has sole authority to export Iraq’s crude, for years the KRG exported independently through a pipeline to Turkey’s Ceyhan port.

stories.title: Why has the FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri? | Explained
stories.summary: On November 22, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), the country’s apex food-safety regulator, sanctioned prosecution against packaged drinking water manufacturer Bisleri International Pvt. Ltd. after a sample of its water was found to be non-compliant with prescribed safety standards, with the regulator declaring it unsafe under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

stories.title: What does ₹1.25L monthly budget look like? ‘ ₹30,000 grocery, ₹20,000 grooming’: Noida couple’s expenses go viral

stories.title: Why BJP is keen on renaming West Bengal ‘Paschim Banga’? | Explained
stories.summary: On November 23, 2026, West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said that the State will be referred to as ‘Paschim Banga’ in all languages including English. Mr. Adhikari said the State Cabinet had passed the proposal and a new resolution to the effect would be tabled in the Assembly on December 9.

stories.title: The price of no climate deal: After COP31, what's next for India and the world | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations (UN) climate summit in Antalya, COP31, ran two days over schedule and ended on November 22 without a cover decision, the overarching text that sums up what a summit achieved. As petrostates like Saudi Arabia and Russia pushed to omit fossil fuels from the final draft, the text was reluctantly accepted by many countries.

stories.title: Why has the INDIA bloc posed 48 questions to the Election Commission over SIR?
stories.summary: The Supreme Court’s decision to hear an application by Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi and other Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) bloc leaders seeking leave to deliver 48 interrogatories to the Election Commission of India (ECI) has added a new dimension to the legal challenge against the nationwide Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

stories.title: Who is Hima Ninama? Teenage aspiring athlete from MP earns David Beckham's praise after stopping her child marriage
stories.summary: A 17-year-old girl from Madhya Pradesh has drawn international attention after refusing to let her family's marriage plans interrupt her education, with former England football captain David Beckham sharing her story on social media to mark World Children's Day. Hima Ninama, a resident of Barkheda village in Jhabua district, stood up against her proposed child marriage while studying in Class 11.

stories.title: Everyday Explained: Why we feel sleepier in a moving car even when we are well-rested
stories.summary: From engine vibrations to monotonous motion, here are the reasons why car rides often make us feel sleepy. Do you also feel sleepy while travelling in a car? You are not the only one to feel that. Feeling sleepy in a moving vehicle is a combination of several factors.

stories.title: Inside COP31’s last 50 hours: A day of waiting, a 3am text, and ‘Simon, take your seat’ | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations climate conference (COP31) in Türkiye's Antalya was supposed to conclude on Friday, November 20, and bring about a negotiated outcome document. It did neither. Delegates spent two more days waiting for texts that came late or not at all, often with little idea of who was negotiating what.

stories.title: Knowledge Nugget | EPFO’s new rules explained: From easier PF withdrawals to payout plan for retirees
stories.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), at the meeting of its Central Board of Trustees (CBT) on November 19, 2026, approved key changes to Provident Fund (PF) withdrawal rules. These include reducing the waiting period for final PF settlement after unemployment from 12 months to two months, lowering the minimum balance that members must retain in their accounts from 25% to 10%, and introducing a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP).

stories.summary: Section 7 empowers courts to appoint a guardian for a minor when necessary for the child's welfare, with the child's best interests outweighing the parents' competing claims. Every school student learns that an answer without the working earns few marks, since the working is how a teacher follows the reasoning.

stories.title: Explainer-Mexico nabs yet another top drug lord, but history of ‘Kingpin Strategy’ mixed
stories.summary: Chapo Isidro was considered one of the leaders of the Beltrán Leyva Organization, a former ally of the powerful Sinaloa Cartel that later became one of its top rivals. stories.title: 8th Pay Commission: Civilian defence staff seek 6% annual increment, OPS and 50% DA merger— 13 key demands explained
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Pratiraksha Mazdoor Sangh (BPMS), an all-India federation of civilian defence employees recognised by the Ministry of Defence, has submitted a fresh list of around 73 demands to the 8th Central Pay Commission (CPC), seeking substantial improvements in salaries, pensions and service benefits for central government employees, particularly defence civilian personnel.

stories.title: What do lemurs and opera singers share?
stories.summary: Have you seen opera performers sing? You might notice how their mouths move according to how high their pitch needs to be. Imagine finding out a primate in the rainforests of Madagascar has been doing the same, possibly even before opera began? With a pointy snout, large eyes and usually a long tail, you might have encountered this primate in one of your favourite movies, Madagascar.

stories.title: Year-round tax planning for salaried employees: a 12-month approach explained
stories.summary: By Archit GuptaEvery person’s personal finance rests on three things. The first is protecting yourself and your family through life and health insurance. The second is your home, and the loan that usually comes with it. The third is building wealth, turning your savings into a corpus that grows over time, whether that corpus is a retirement fund decades away or simply money set aside for a year-end holiday.

stories.title: Dalai Lama, office allotted bungalow in Lutyens' Delhi
stories.summary: The Centre has assigned a government bungalow in Lutyens' Delhi to Tibetan spiritual leader the Dalai Lama. This official accommodation aims to facilitate his visits to the national capital and provide comfort. Members of the Tibetan parliament-in-exile have welcomed this arrangement as a supportive gesture towards their community.

stories.title: Srinagar's Ancient Durgeshwari Temple Reopens After 37 Years; Here's Why It Deserves A Spot On Your Travel Itinerary
stories.summary: Srinagar, known for its picturesque Dal Lake, snow-capped mountains and beautiful gardens, is also home to several ancient temples that reflect Kashmir's rich cultural and spiritual heritage. One such historic landmark, the Durgeshwari Temple, reopened on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, after remaining closed for nearly 37 years. The temple was closed due to militancy and the Kashmiri exodus.
